verification_method: Independent direct OpenCascade BRepAlgoAPI_Common on exported STEP, actual submitted transforms. All base seats and neighboring pairs; sampled withdrawal; representative stack gauges and compartment probes. No design generator executed.
capacity_assessment: Free-volume gauges establish geometric space only. Submitted ISO nominal hardware dimensions and loose-packing estimates were read but not accepted as independent physical capacity proof; actual 20-screw/30-nut/30-washer loading and tiny-part retrieval remain untested.
limitations: Rigid STEP checks omit printer tolerance, warp, friction, filled handling, and physical pour/retrieval trials.
Withdrawal and sightlines are discrete samples, not a continuous motion/visibility proof.
No independent printed/sliced specimen exists; font labels and source use were visually inspected; exact bead resolution requires slicer preview.

capacity_estimate.method: Direct OCP measures actual void inside per-compartment rectangular bounds below shelf/lip. Nominal hardware dimensions read from submission; solid head/shank cylinders, full hex-prism nuts and full washer disks conservatively ignore holes. 60% packing is an unvalidated estimate, not a loading test.

compartment_probe_interpretation: Rectangular volume probes intentionally include some solid scoop/shelf ramps; nonzero intersection records occupied volume, not a failed fit gauge. Actual free volumes are reported separately in capacity_estimate.

access_detail.method: 14mm square open-top finger probe above each shelf; conservative overall screw boxes in largest 20mm compartments. Geometry only, no human retrieval claim.
